text: Based on the evidence, the property did not lose 67.7 ha of tree cover after the EUDR cut-off date of December 31, 2020. The tool detected no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 ha or more within the asset between 2021 and 2025. The largest tree-cover loss event recorded was 67.7 ha, but this occurred in 2020, which is outside the claim interval. Therefore, the property did not experience significant tree-cover loss after the specified cut-off date.
